description: This file defines a serializer class for the TimeOnly struct in .NET 6.0 or greater, providing methods for writing and reading TimeOnly values for serialization purposes.

classes.name: TimeOnlyCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec<TimeOnly> for serializing and deserializing TimeOnly values.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Writes a TimeOnly value to the buffer writer with a field header, using the value's Ticks property.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Static method for writing a TimeOnly value without type info, optimized with aggressive inlining.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a TimeOnly value from the reader, verifying wire type and constructing TimeOnly from Ticks.
